Final component-resampled near levels retain regular dome rings, actual recessed ports, pierced gallery support, drum graphics, transparent lantern and optical representation. Skyline/district preserve the taper, octagonal gallery, red dome and oil store; district uses flat port marks and opaque simplified glazing. Noon/late and economy/high views fit the synthetic Swedish-cottage palette. Four same-camera transitions maintain stable height and massing.

limitations: The modeled exterior follows the cited published facts and inspected photographs. Unpublished dimensions and local fittings are explicitly photo-proportioned; no claim of engineering survey accuracy is made.
Portable PBR and shared metric surfaces are provided. Surface weathering, material color under local lighting and fine facade relief require close render review before maximum-detail acceptance.
